reviewer_gap: The confirmatory terminal experiment has success-label-memory and failure-label-memory conditions but no fresh no-memory terminal arm, so it cannot locate either memory-conditioned branch relative to memory omission.
decision_rationale: The requested no-memory arm is a genuinely new treatment and cannot be inferred from the two existing confirmatory arms.
The arm is nevertheless a narrow secondary control: it does not change the write-time intervention, source memories, future-task support, model, evaluator, or primary F2R1 estimand.
The strongest remaining paper-value gain is interpretability of the confirmed terminal shift, not a new memory-writer or three-arm-method claim.
The existing 12 no-memory calls belong to the earlier non-passing exploratory terminal stage and are excluded from confirmatory inference.
Research-OS authority rules forbid treating generic continuation or this AI-authored design as scientific/experiment execution authority.

authority.required_before_execution: A separate external content-addressed human authorization artifact that explicitly names PROXY-O5, this frozen contract SHA256, the 32-call ceiling, and permission for provider calls.

prior_f2r1_authorization.reason: It authorizes only the prior two-arm F2R1 scope and cannot authorize a new no-memory treatment.

scientific_contract.question: For each frozen future task, where does the memory-free terminal success probability lie relative to the already-confirmed success-label-memory and failure-label-memory branches?
scientific_contract.primary_f2r1_estimand_unchanged: mean across 16 frozen source-future cells of absolute difference in benchmark terminal success rate between success-label-memory and failure-label-memory conditions
scientific_contract.treatment_definition: Use the identical fixed-evidence future-task prompt/policy construction as F2R1 but omit the persistent memory content entirely; do not replace it with an irrelevant-memory, placebo, summary, or empty-looking token payload.
scientific_contract.source_independence: The no-memory treatment contains no source-memory object, so a no-memory rollout is indexed only by future task and fresh rollout index. The same estimated future-task baseline may be referenced by all four source-memory comparison cells but must never be counted four times as independent evidence.

fresh_units.unit: one fresh provider response for one frozen future task under literal no-memory omission

model.substitution_rule: If the exact F2R1 model/provider semantics cannot be reproduced, STOP rather than substitute another model, including a cheaper plan model or DeepSeek, because substitution changes the comparison object.

missingness_policy.interpretation_if_any_provider_failure: Report the incomplete arm and its selection limitation. Do not silently top up, replace, or change the task set. A fresh separately authorized recovery contract would be required for any additional call.

analysis_contract.new_no_memory_rate: For each future task f, estimate p0(f) from exactly 8 fresh binary benchmark outcomes.
analysis_contract.uncertainty: Report 95% Wilson intervals for each of the four new no-memory rates and Newcombe-style score intervals for each memory-minus-no-memory contrast. Preserve the shared p0(f) dependence across the four source comparisons for a given future task.
analysis_contract.branch_location_table: For every one of the 16 frozen source-by-future cells, report the F2R1 success-memory rate, F2R1 failure-memory rate, shared future-task no-memory rate, both contrasts, and uncertainty. Classify only the point-estimate geometry as BASELINE_BETWEEN_ARMS, BASELINE_CLOSER_TO_SUCCESS, BASELINE_CLOSER_TO_FAILURE, or EQUIDISTANT; do not turn this descriptive class into a new significance claim.
analysis_contract.reason_no_global_gate: O5 is a reviewer-requested interpretability control over a primary effect already confirmed by F2R1. Reusing four source-independent baselines as sixteen pseudo-independent observations would create a misleading significance test.
analysis_contract.old_exploratory_no_memory_role: The 12 earlier no-memory calls may be displayed only as historical exploratory context after the fresh analysis is frozen; they are excluded from the confirmatory estimator, intervals, and any decision rule.
outcome_invariant_completion_gate: The pre-execution contract and authorization hashes verify.
Exactly 32 calls are requested: 8 for each of the four frozen future tasks.
No source dimension is introduced into the no-memory treatment.
Every completed response is scored by the exact frozen F2R1 evaluator.
All failures, if any, remain visible without replacement or imputation.

allowed_if_executed: Describe where each memory-conditioned terminal branch lies relative to a fresh memory-free baseline on the same four frozen future tasks.
Use the no-memory arm to distinguish cases consistent with one branch moving away from omission from cases where both memory branches differ from omission.
State explicitly that the control is finite-support and shares a future-task baseline across source comparisons.
forbidden: Recast C4 as a three-arm randomized causal effect across an independent 4x4x3 factorial design.
Count one no-memory rollout four times across source memories.
Pool the 12 exploratory no-memory calls into the fresh confirmatory arm.
Change the four future tasks after seeing outcomes.
Use a favorable no-memory result to expand cross-model, live-WebArena, full-memory-bank, or general population claims.
Interpret an unfavorable or incomplete no-memory control as refuting the already-supported two-arm F2R1 effect without a separately preregistered equivalence/falsification contract.

economy.why_32_is_minimal_matched_scope: Eight rollouts matches the per-condition F2R1 cell replication depth, while no-memory has no source-memory factor and therefore requires only four future-task strata.

next_gate.on_authority: Bind the authorization artifact SHA256 into a run-local copy of this contract, verify all source hashes and exact model/evaluator settings, then permit at most 32 provider calls.
next_gate.without_authority: Keep PROXY-O5 blocked and retain the current R3 paper-only no-memory limitation.
